content.text:
Which **Glenwood Pool** do you mean? A few common matches are:

1. **Glenwood Pool / Glenwood Recreation Club** — Forest Glen / Silver Spring, Maryland  
   Address: **10012 Gardiner Ave, Silver Spring, MD 20902**; phone **301-681-7599**. It’s a nonprofit swim club with membership, swim/dive teams, and summer hours. ([glenwoodpool.org](https://glenwoodpool.org/?utm_source=openai))

2. **Glenwood Hot Springs Pool** — Glenwood Springs, Colorado  
   A hot-springs resort pool complex. ([hotspringspool.com](https://hotspringspool.com/?utm_source=openai))

3. **Glenwood Pool** — Macomb, Illinois  
   Public pool in Glenwood Park. ([enjoyillinois.com](https://www.enjoyillinois.com/explore/listing/glenwood-pool/?utm_source=openai))
